review_description: Great experience with the guys. Unfortunately they went into liquidation.

A great team from Wildman Solar. The whole process was well organised and the quality of material and workmanship was second to none. Everything went to plan and I am now enjoying all the benefits of solar energy supplying all my household needs.

We had a fantastic experience with Wildman Solar from start to finish. The sales and quoting process was smooth, transparent, and hassle-free. They provided a clear and competitive quote, answered all our questions promptly, and ensured we understood every step of the process.The installation itself was exceptional. The team arrived on time, worked efficiently, and maintained a polite and friendly attitude throughout. Their attention to detail was outstanding—they kept everything tidy and concealed most of the wiring, leaving us with a clean and professional-looking setup.The customer service was also excellent. After the installation, they took the time to show us how to use the Tesla Powerwall 3, ensuring we were comfortable with our new system.We couldn’t be happier with the work Wildman Solar did for us and would highly recommend them to anyone looking for a professional, reliable, and customer-focused installer.

These lads are very good, very friendly and very informative of what they are doing, explained the whole process to me.Very professional job, when I decide to get a battery I will go with them!Did a great job, I had the Catch Control installed, had an issue with it, they came out and solved the issue, working great now!

Very happy with the sales process.Displayed knowledge and provided options with reasons.The installation went well, installers were very polite and courteous.The installers were tidy and cleaned up after themselves.Very happy with end result.

The whole experience with Wildman Solar was pretty seamless, from the quote provided, right through the installation process.Any changes that needed to be made were communicated by the team, with a full explantation as to the reasoning behind the decision.The team that carried out the installation were brilliant……knowledgeable, professional, punctual, friendly….could not fault them.

I recently had the pleasure of working with Wildman Solar for the installation of a solar energy system at my home in Western Sydney, and I couldn't be happier with the experience.From the very first consultation, the team at Wildman Solar demonstrated exceptional professionalism and expertise. They patiently answered all my questions, provided detailed information about the solar installation process, and helped me understand the benefits and savings I could expect.The installation process was smooth and efficient, with the team working diligently to complete the project on time. They took care of all the necessary paperwork and approvals, making the entire process hassle-free for me.Wildman Solar were always available to address any concerns I had and kept me informed at every stage of the project.Since the installation, my electricity bills have significantly decreased, and I feel great knowing that I'm contributing to a more sustainable future. The solar system has performed flawlessly, and the monitoring app provided by Wildman Solar allows me to track my energy production and usage in real-time.Wildman Solar understands the unique needs and conditions of our area. They provided tailored solutions that were perfectly suited to my home's requirements and the local climate and I wholeheartedly recommend Wildman Solar to anyone considering a solar energy system.Thank you, Wildman Solar, for making my transition to solar energy a seamless and rewarding experience!

The whole process from quotation to connecting to the grid was as smooth as it can be.First I would like to thank Taylor, who was absolutely open to any question and quoted multiple options, which made it easy for me to do like to like comparison.On the day of the installation too, the technicians were on time and provided enough explanations of their work.They also organised the grid connection which I would say took a lot of hassle away from me.Thanks "Team Wildman"
Wildman Solar were punctual, professional and pleasant to deal with. The guys that did the install were polite and explained the process really well.

From the detailed quotation process, to the tidy installation, to the ongoing assistance and support. In my opinion Wildman Solar has outshone it's competitors. They tailored a solution to suit our needs and very informative throughout and beyond the process. All the while, remaining competitively priced. It made the most sense to support this local business.

Sales person who answered all my questions, visited on site, took time to explain all options. The PV panels installation was extremely neat and tidy, all workmen were punctual and polite. There was a hiccup after with the inverter and a company  person  was there within a day to rectify it.
Wildman Solar were competitively priced using only recommended components. They were professional, punctual, and provided excellent follow-up service. I thoroughly recommend this company.

Wildman Solar are thoroughly recommended.We were accorded a seamless integration from initial very informed hassle free quote, through the install process and final handover and grid connection.A highly professional & thoughtful team that left our premises as they were when they arrived.All aspects were thoroughly explained including any after-sales requirements.Can't thank Zech Wildman and his team enough.

One phone call is all it took to get the process underway. Installaion was sooner than expected. The whole install was completed quickly with little disruption to the household. Very polite and friendly staff made the whole process easy and enjoyable. Answered all questions without hesitation. Explained the whole set-up and left the worksite clean and tidy. I would whole heartedly recommend Josh and his workers. More than happy

Initial contact was prompt. Wildman Solar representative was very professional and easy to talk with; very knowledgeable and explained and answered all our enquiries. Quote was emailed by the end of the day. Wildman Solar admin was friendly and kept us informed and guided us in what was expected. On installation day, the Wildman Solar team arrived on time. Team leader introduced himself and explained the installation process. All of the installers were polite and courteous. Following installation, the site was left tidy. We were very happy with the placement of the panels as well as the Enphase iBoard with protective cover. We would highly recommend Wildman Solar.

Sales processes was pretty easy and answered all my questions. Didn't feel like I was rushed to make decisions to complete the purchase. Installation went as communicated and on time. They also cleaned up and explained everything about the system to ensure I was comfortable to look after the system.Overall their customer service and commitment to customer satisfaction was exceptional
Sales, easy to communicate with, installation / tradesmen were punctual, tidy & efficient

Quoting was efficient and professional.The installation was very professional and handled by a professional team with excellent manners.After install they assisted us with the update of the meter that was required and went through the shut down procedures if required for any reason.All in all top service from Wildman electrical.
We really appreciated the personal service. They answered all our questions. The installation went smoothly and they have sorted out the connection with our electricity provider.

Wildman Solar was one of the installers I received through Solarquotes. Dom was very professional, understood what I was looking for and answered all my questions. After a few conversations, Wildman Solar just felt like the right people to go with.Zac and the crew were ontime and even a bit of rain didn't stop them from getting the job done. They were polite and accommodating to were I want the inverter installed. Place was tidy after install was done.Customer service has been great from start to finish! Danielle has been getting back to me even after install was done. Wildman Solar also help organise the grid connection, solar installation was done just before the Xmas and New Year break. They followed up with my vendor after the New Year when they notice there was still no confirmation response.All in all, Wildman Solar have been Fantastic and my experience have been great.

I reached out to Wildman Solar through Solar quotes and they were great to deal with. Helped me understand the whole process. Answered my questions patiently. Understood my future needs and recommended a premium system at an affordable price. On the day of installation they arrived promptly and did the whole job very professionally. I really liked the fact that they have their own installation team unlike others who outsource the job which sometimes leads to quality issues. Really happy with them and would highly recommend them to everyone.

Highly recommend! They kept me informed throughout the process. Super professional during install. Cleaned up. They treated our house with respect and the staff were all so polite. Support and use these guys you will not regret.

Dom from Wildman Solar is a knowledgeable and respectful professional who provides outstanding customer service and attention to detail. Throughout the quotation process, we contacted multiple solar companies over the course of a month and due to Dom's customer service and quality product, we decided to engage Wildman Solar.The installation process was flawless, Zac and his team were outstanding. They were punctual, polite, tidy and the quality of the work speaks volumes of the quality and integrity of their company.We could not be happier with our Wildman Solar panels and accompanying system, the entire process was fantastic and I could not endorse their company more highly as they are exceptional.

Joshua rang me to say he was running a bit late. Joshua explained everything about the systems on offer and answered all my questions to  my satisfaction. My follow up phone calls with questions were answered promptly.

The process from initial contact through to installation was seamless. Josh was polite and factual in his explanation of the system, potential savings versus cost and at no time did we feel pressured. The installation was brilliant, the guys were friendly and diligent, punctual and hard working. Would not hesitate in  recommending Wildman Solar.

From the first quote to the end of the process Wildman Solar were clear and helpful. They took care to make sure I knew what I needed to know. They didn't push one product on me, but talked through the pros and cons of different approaches. They got to know all my preferences and wishes and came up with a solution that worked best. At multiple points they went the extra mile to make sure I got the best possible solution, rather than just 'close enough'. At the install itself they took as much care as possible to make it neat and tidy and organised. the crew on site were polite and friendly and even happy to chat with my kids.

It was great dealing with Wildman Solar with special mention to Dom from the Sales/Quoting team.  Dom was great and has been patient in answering all my questions without hard selling.  Pricing is reasonable knowing that i will get quality service and products including the materials used in their installation giving me peace of mind.  The installers are well experienced as the whole installation process went smoothly and they are nice too.  Great team!
The team at Wildman solar gave me a couple of options to choose from with the benefits outlined. This made the narrowing down the best choice easier.

The pre-sales, system design and on site install was great. The equipment has been working well smashing our power bills.The post sales service, response to questions and options to tune the installation was very poor.Direct support from Fronius was very poor.

Dom gave me a comprehensive initial quote and followed up with a revised quote to include some alternative components I had requested. We had existing pool solar heating panels and piping that had to be removed to allow installation of the new solar panels and this was no problem for Dom to include for in his quotation (unlike some other installers).I had cheaper quotes from other installers but based on Dom's quote, together with his answers to quite a few questions I had, I decided to go with Wildman Solar and have had no regrets on my decision.Installation of the solar system was done on the days Wildman Solar originally advised and was very tidy and complete.After installation they organized for grid connection and hopefully this will not take too long to happen.All the Wildman Solar crew from sales to installation were very polite and professional.So far, a great company who I would highly recommend to anyone considering Solar.
Outstanding experience that offered competitive pricing, exceptional customer service, and a seamless installation process. Recommended.

Quoting process was not pushy and based on a sound understanding of the technology.The installation was professional and efficient.Customer service is fantastic.Form process was seamless.The price is a bit more than the other suppliers, but you get what you pay for.

Very professional. Very helpful.Polite, respectful, efficient, the installation was carried out without issue.A special shout out though to Dom, in sales. Tremendously helpful. Brilliant employee and true asset to the company.
Wildman solar exceeded expectations. The whole process was very simple and the installation and guys doing the job were first class.Highly recommend.

Following sourcing a number of quotations on my own, I came across Wildman Solar through Solar Quotes, and obtained their quotation, which as it turned out was more cost effective than the other quotations, while using better quality materials - including the Fronius Inverter.From the outset, the customer service I received was nothing short of outstanding with Dom and Danielle handling my multitude of enquiries in the office, phone calls were returned, and further communication by both sms and emails made sure that I was well informed along every step of the way during the entire process from day one up to and AFTER the installation,The installers turned up on time, worked without fuss, completed the job, helped me set up up the Fronius App , and made sure that I was happy with the system and its workings.All in all, from my own experience,  I cannot speak highly enough of the Wildman staff and installers, they were a credit to their company, and I would have absolutely no hesitation in recommending them.

From the first phone call to the installation everything went very smoothly. Josh, Zac and their team were knowledgeable, polite, tidy and their attention to detail was outstanding.  Any questions we asked were answered and Danielle in the office nothing was a problem.  I wouldn't hesitate to recommend Wildman Solar.

Wildman Solar are a very professional company from Dom the sales representative who on multiple times answered all my queries in regards to different options and Zach and his team of installers that guided me through every step of the process, including dealing with my energy retailer in the replacement of my meter including the follow-up on the systems operation which then Zach pinpointed an issue and carried out the necessary adjustments to the system. The level of detail from this company is second to none, and is very hard to find these days and I wouldn’t hesitate in recommending Wildman Solar.

The process from start to finish was easy with the team from Wildman Solar. The whole crew were polite, respectful, tidy and had total attention to detail during the entire install process. They were knowledgeable about every aspect and always happy to answer any questions. I can't imagine there would be any other installer who could do better than Joshua & Zechariah and their team.

From the first phone call to the installation, every member of the Wildman Solar team were polite, helpful and professional. They supplied quotes for two systems (micro inverter and string inverter) so we could easily compare them and we happy to answer all our questions. I was pleasantly surprised how tidy the installers were - they didn't leave any rubbish behind.

From the moment I was contacted by Wildman till now the customer service has been amazing. Dom was very knowlegable and helpful - solar can seem like a mine field and Dom was so good at providing the information.Their pricing was competive - but it was the customer service that won me over.The install arrived as agreed and were very professional and were able to make a few tweaks to the plan to give me the best solar outcome.I'm so happy with Wildman Solar that they will be installing for my daughter and I would hesitate in recommending the team.
The team from Wildman solar did an excellent job from 1st phone call to the installation.Everything was done on time-  work and correspondenceHighly recommend Wildman solar

The team were efficient, communicative and very professional.Absolutely no issues at all.Quoting provided all the information we needed and they sorted out everything with our service provider.Very happy.
The team at Wildman were great. They listened to my needs and were punctual and professional. Thanks to Dom and the team.

I recently had the pleasure of working with Taylor Binns from Wildman Solar. The experience exceeded all expectations. From the moment I spoke with Taylor over the phone, his dedication to providing top-notch customer service and the best solution, was evident.Taylor's approach was refreshingly customer-centric. He was very comfortable to talk to, right off the bat. His knowledge and expertise in the solar industry were impressive, and he freely provided me with comprehensive information and guidance without the guarantee of a sale. He never criticised the competition (unlike other companies I engaged for quotes) and in fact, gave credit where credit was due to Wildman Solar's competition. That showed me the confidences he had in Wildman Solar's service.Throughout the entire process, Taylor ensured that I felt confident and informed, addressing any questions or uncertainties I had. His professionalism and responsiveness were exemplary, making the entire journey smooth and stress-free.On the day of the installation, Taylor and his team demonstrated utmost care and skill. The entire process was impeccably executed. Not only did they complete the installation fast and efficiently, but they also left my property spotless; as if they were never here. It was a testament to their commitment to providing a white-glove experience. The only negative I can think of is I wish I was asked about the location of the Enphase board installation.Wildman Solar tried to do the leg work for upgrading our meter but our provider would not let them needing me to do it. I appreciate the effort though.The performance of our system has been great. Our total spend since install would have been $659.67 but instead, it is $289.42 (56% reduction in our bill). See attached screenshot. The Enphase interface into the system (both phone app and desktop web) is very good, giving both a great high level and detailed view.I can strongly recommend Taylor Binns and Wildman Solar for their outstanding service. Taylor's dedication, expertise, and genuine care make him a true professional in his field. If you are looking for a solar solution with exceptional customer service and an installation executed flawlessly, look no further than Taylor and the team at Wildman Solar. They're the best.Thank you, Taylor, for going above and beyond to ensure my satisfaction. I am thrilled with the outcome and grateful for the exceptional service you and the team provided.
Really great to deal with. Great sales, installers when advised by a great team that just came and got it done
Very smooth operation from 1st contact, to site visit, to installation.

Josh was fantastic and patient from our first call discussing battery options for our setup. Nothing was a hassle! Install went very smoothly and the quality of their workmanship was top notch and will happily recommend the team to friends and family.

1)The quoting process was really good.2)The installation went very well & the team were polite & punctual.3)The customer service was excellent & the installers were professional.4)The installers worked very well together as a good team to provide a great result.

Forget about getting quotes, Wildman Solar are your go to team.Wildman solar were brilliant from the start. Very informative and direct about their products. They offered a range of products that helped me narrow down my choices, which I found not many solar companies do. I dealt with Zach all the way through to installation and beyond, and he helped me answer any questions I had (even till now) without hesitation and delay. The Wildman Solar team were very polite, efficient and tidy during the entire process and the final product blew me away. I highly recommend the Wildman Solar team for any solar project.

I was getting quote for Solar from various solar installers including solar quotes referred platinum installers, however they all don’t want to listen what I say and they enforce things which easy for them, example cut 3 x exhaust pipe(stink pipe) on my roof and told me there is no other way to install 20 sun power maxeon 6 panels of 8.4 KW in  3 roof space of my 2 storey home.However finally I found Zech from Wildman solar, his quote was very competitive and also he listened what I wanted and gave me quote to install 20 sun power maxeon panels in 3 x roof space plus lower level too without cutting/trimming exhaust pipes on roof.He was very polite, honest and prompt on communicative when delay in panel supply. He answer all my doubts without any hesitant too.Zech and his team came in late October 2022 and neatly installed panels and installed an envoy box inside the fence as I requested and no cables visible on roof space too. They took around 6 hours to install and clean up all rubbish allWell done Zech and team keep up the good work, wishing them and Wildman Solar to expand the business to other states as well.

Of the three providers offered by Solar Quotes, Wildman Solar was the only one that provided a quote. They were on to it straight away. They offered a Fronius Wattpilot. We have had a Fronius inverter with our solar PV panels for about seven years without any problems. So, it seemed like a no-brainer  to  get the Wattpilot, as it integrates with our existing system and offers great features. After a few minutes learning how to use the app, I’m now running my EV on only sunshine. Zach and Rogers came on time, did the job and were very pleasant and generous with their time and knowledge. It took them more than four hours to complete the install and it was much more complex than I had imagined. I was going to get the very good electrician to do the installation, but I noted Finn’s very good advice to get the equipment from the specialist installer. I recommend Wildman Solar without any reservation.

How was the sales/quoting process?Very detailed and straight to the point, helped explain pros and cons of technologies and was open to recommendations and alternativesHow did the installation go? Polite? Tidy? Punctual?Smooth, fast and efficient.How was the customer service? e.g. did they help organise the grid connection after the install?Absolutely amazing, they handled everything and had full trust on what they were doing.

From initial quote through to final installation I found this company to be highly professional and personable. They politely and patiently answered all my concerns throughout the whole process. On the day of installation they were very punctual (given the distance they had to travel), performed all aspects required to mount the solar panels properly and securely on my roof and secured the inverter and all electrical components to a very high standard. I was extremely impressed with the entire process and would not hesitate to recommend this company to anyone interested.
Taylor and his crew were fantastic.Taylor’s communication before, during and after installation was impeccable.So lovely to deal with, and so honest.Thanks again

The work carried out by Wildman Solar team to install a solar system in my property was phenomenal. The team indicated a timeslot to arrive at the property, duration of work to be performed, turn off power to connect the solar system well in advance. I was initially told that the power will be shut off for an hour but it turns out that the power was only turned off for 10 mins, causing minimal disruption. The Wildman team had everything planned and lined up well and executed with minimal impact which is a great achievement. The team at Wildman Solar had always kept me updated during the entire process starting from generating the initial quote for solar system to organizing all the paper work to connect to the  grid. I am very happy with Wildman Solar.

Such a professional team. The team came to our property to inspect the site and discuss suitable solar options both AC and DC . We received the quotes on the same day as the inspection. The guys were extremely patient with us as we worked through obtaining a green loan from the commonwealth bank. Wildman Solar ticked all the boxes for accreditation.Installation was hassle free, the team was always polite,tidy and punctual.The supply, installation,testing and commissioning as well as arranging grid connection was seamless.We had the system 8.8kw AC solar system installed in September 22 and it has far exceeded our expectations reaching higher outputs than what was envisaged within the quotes.We consider Wildman Solar a tier one solar company and recommend them to all those considering a solar system.Thank you Wildman Solar for providing a solar system that is second to none.Aleshia

Wildman installed the solar system of solar panels (Qcells) and an inverter (Fronius) at our home. The job was carried out to a high standard and they upgraded the inverter for nothing. Fully recommend this company and the employees.

We recently had a solar system installed at our home in Bilpin by Wildman Solar. Taylor and the team are the best bunch of people around. Polite, professional and hard working.  They just got on with the job and obviously know what they are doing,  We had a small problem with the power supply into the property and Taylor quickly had that sorted and attended to within 24 hours.We would highly recommend Wildman Solar.  Great team.  Great product.

Right from the get go, Taylor was very happy to answer any question i had for him. He had also called me on a Friday afternoon, and as i was heading to work, asked him if he would be able to give me a call on Saturday morning to organise a quote. He said that it wouldn't be a problem and called me at 10am Saturday.The quote he gave me was very competitive and we decided to go with Wildman. This was the best decision we could have made as other installers continually rubbished each other trying to scare me into going with them. Taylor never once asked me what other quotes I got or tried to rubbish other installers who had given me a quote. Taylor just focused on what they could offer and put my mind at ease with any question that I had for him.As tradesmen, Taylor, Zech, and Josh are some of the best tradesmen that I've ever had to deal with. Polite and super respectful not to damage anything on my property and of course fantastic installers. The job they did was flawless. When I look at other houses in my street and the dodgy jobs other installers have done compared to mine, it puts my mind at ease that this was money well spent. Things like rails cut to perfection and the inverter installed without running wires down conduit but instead internally routed down my wall to the inverter.I will most certainly be using Wildman for any electrical job I need around the house as they are truly legendary sparkys and cannot recommend them enough. Ive attached some photos of the outstanding job they did installing my solar.

As at writing this review, our installation date is still a few weeks off.I always expected the process of setting requirements and negotiating the required system was going to be fraught due primarily to the fact that I knew very little about solar photovoltaic systems.I found that Wildman Solar took the time to: understand, question, and advise; on the system. It was very helpful that the salesman was also an electrician, and was able to explain to me what expectations I should have from the system, particularly when the grid went down and I was only on battery power. He went to great lengths to explain what the limitations of the battery would be, and what electrical systems I could run when the grid was down and why.

I was looking to replace my 1.5Kw system with a 6.6kw system. I elected to only have two quotes through SolarQuotes and received both quotes promptly. I decided to go locally and used Wildman Solar. Naturally I did some checks, by reading some reviews and checking out their ABN. This team of young men have only been in business for a little over 18 months, but don't let that put you off, as everybody has to start somewhere. This team of young men know the products,present well, are very polite, very accommodating with design and answering any questions I had for them.Their workmanship is second to none and I have no hesitations in recommending them.If you are thinking of getting a solar system make sure one of your quotes is from Wildman Solar, and if you decide to use them, I am sure you will be like me, a very happy customer.

I would like to thank Taylor and his entire team, who ensured that the process to install Solar was smooth from start to finish.They were able to answer and satisfy all my questions before I made a decision while being super friendly, courteous and not at all pushy.Installation went ahead as planned.  Taylor's team were punctual, polite, professional and very tidy with their work.Grid connection all sorted on their end with no problems experienced.I would not hesitate to recommend Wildman Solar for anyone wanting to get their first Solar System installed.
Very good communication from the team.Knowledgeable, polite and hardworking  installers. Excellent work done.Very happy with results!

The quoting process with Wildman Solar was very easy and informative. Their pricing on a quality solar system was realistic and very competitive. They arrived on time and as planned. Each tradesman introduced themselves and were very polite and courteous. I was very impressed with their safe manor of work. Advising me of the installation process before doing their safety checks and requirements of placing safety barriers around the job site.The installation of my quality Solar system went very smoothly. I'm extremely happy with my new solar system from Wildman Solar and the great service I received. Wildman Solar were very professional in all aspects and I would highly recommend them.

I went with Wildman Solar because of how engaging Taylor was from the outset, he provided me two quotes for my house and as I learned more about solar he did a third quote to include a hot water relay in the system. I made it clear to Taylor I wanted something that performed well and looked the part on my roof and on the day of the installation it was clear I made a great choice. My panels are perfectly centred on my roof, evenly distributed and perfectly aligned. All wiring from panels to circuit board were run in the wall cavities with not a single piece of conduit to be seen. After sales support as also been top notch from both Taylor and Zech who have helped me understand the system monitoring.I have already recommended Wildman Solar to a couple of my colleagues, two great guys for sure!
Taylor was very helpful in providing different options and we are very pleased with the Wildman Solar installation service.

From the initial phone conversation right through to installation the process was seamless and all the team were easy to deal with. All questions answered in detailed and no pressure to make a decision quickly. Price was comparable to other quotes and comparison quotes for different systems completed . Installation day went without any issues the guys were efficient, friendly, tidy and explained everything thoroughly. Post installation paperwork and set up was all completed by Wildman Solar. Highly recommend.

Wildman Solar were fantastic - from prompt responses to questions, to clear explanations of what seemed quite confusing at first, to a quick, quiet and tidy install. The solar is working as expected.They were also lovely people [not a prerequisite but nice when spending so much money]. Although I have paid them they continue to promptly answer the questions I forgot at the time and patiently respond to repeat questions.I absolutely recommend Wildman Solar.

The team turned up when advised and were very professional, diligently working away and advising me of all the things they were doing and what to expect as the installation progressed. They were very polite and left everything neat and tidy after helping me connect the system to the web. I would, and have recommended them to my friends - Sharon Huxley

From the first call the team at Wildman Solar were conversational and willing to investigate a broad range of solutions. We quoted up both string systems and micro-inverters with ranges of panels and capacities.What sold me was that in investigating what I wanted, and why I was going to solar, it came up I was having the roof resealed and repainted. The team suggested getting the footings for the panels in before the paint, minimising disruption to the finished surface and ensuring maximum waterproofness.This split their visit in two but they were happy to accomodate.I subsequently mentioned the repainting to other companies that I talked to but clearly none saw the progression of work in same way as I, or the team at Wildman did.I'm very happy with all aspects of the job the team did as well as the presentation of the final product and feel confident the work was done to the highest levels of safety and compliance.I would recommend the team at Wildman to others without reservation.

Wildman Solar were amazing. Zech and the boys were on time and explained the system installation along every step of the way. I would recommend them to anybody looking at having a system installed. From quotation to installation and after sales service were all seamless, and the system is delivering more energy than I ever thought was possible.

Wildman Solar were professional and reliable from the first contact to installation. They were the only company to visit our house in order to quote. The quote was competitive and their communication flawless. I would highly recommend Wildman Solar.

The sales and quoting process was extremely streamlined and going thru SolarQuotes helps immensely as it provides that added layer of protection of the installation.With so much of confusing information and price points all over the place, it’s almost impossible for someone to make a well informed decision.If not for SolarQuotes I would not have been able to make an informed decision.Installations is yet pending. Would be good if I could have the opportunity to provide feedback on the install once done. Should be in the next couple of months.

Zech and the team at Wildman Solar provided exemplary service throughout the process. They arrived promptly, investigated the area for best possible placement of the panels, and thoroughly explained my options.On the day of the install they arrived on time and worked solidly to complete the install of my 8.4 system.Their communication was excellent, the service was very reasonably priced, and I couldn’t fault any aspect.I am very happy with the result and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Wildman Solar for anyone who is looking for quality workmanship.

Zach Wildman and his staff did a great job installing my 7.4KW system. Would recommend that company  to anyone. Their services are the best fair prices and honest people to deal with. Again thank you for your services and have no regrets using Wildman solar to do the job.
